title: Majestic Sardinia : A Yoga & Nature Retreat

hero_image.alt: Turquoise water in a cove ringed by granite rocks on the coast of Sardinia, Italy

intro: One of the loveliest places we have visited, Sardinia kind of has it all! Its spectacular beaches with crystal clear waters, stunning vistas and dreamy nature baths, ancient ruins steeped with history, rich agriculture and undeniably incredible food, olive oils and wines make Sardinia a place that we are SO thrilled to share with you!
about_body: We honestly had a hard time narrowing this one down but we believe we have curated a fantastic glimpse into this charming island that will wet your whistle and get you excited to learn more. Our retreat begins in the northwest corner near the Maddalena Islands, the star child of Sardinia boasting otherworldly rock formations, pristine waters and arguably the best beaches on the island. We spend three nights and three days exploring this area, enjoying the beaches, taking to the waters for a luxury boating excursion, checking out the nooks and crannies in kayaks or paddle boats and finally a day hike in the breath taking Moon Valley at that golden hour when the light makes everything just magical.

We feel any trip to Sardinia wouldn’t be complete without a perspective shift to the majestic mountain landscapes in the middle of the island. We fell in LOVE with the central east coast and are so thrilled to take you to our favorite farmhouse and art hotel to enjoy their authentic experiences, mouth watering cuisine, and hiking and excursions to round out the experience.

accommodations.label: Beachfront hotel near the Maddalena Islands
text: Our adventure will take us to the northwest corner of the island near the world renowned Maddalena Islands to enjoy the finest of the Sardinian coastline.

Modern beachfront accommodations will be our home for three nights as we enjoy the stunning beauty of the Mediterranean Sea right outside our door. We decided that the oceanfront rooms were too expensive to include in the package because you’re not really in your room that often but if you’d like to upgrade please let us know and we will check availability.
Enjoy the beachfront loungers, beach bar, kayak and paddleboat rentals, swimming pool and spa in your free time.
Clean, modern rooms, fabulous haute Sardinian cuisine, local wines and friendly staff make this beachfront hotel our choice for this incredible adventure.

accommodations.label: Farmhouse & art hotel in Barbagia
text: Moving on to the mountains for a stark contrast to the crisp and clean experience in the north, we will enjoy our last three nights at an experience, art hotel nestled in Barbagia.
Authentic Sardinian cooking techniques, art workshops and unique decor make this hotel the most intriguing stay.
Charming accommodations with single or twin beds and ensuite bathrooms are tucked into each corner of the property.
A different dining experience each night, yoga with a view, and plenty of places to tuck in and take in the Sardinian lifestyle await.

travel_tips.heading: Travel Tips
items: OLB Olbia Airport is the most convenient airport to arrive into for our adventure. The first hotel is about an hour from there and we can pair travelers coming in on similar flight itineraries together. There is another airport about three hours away in the south of the island called Cagliari which you might consider if you are looking to extend your stay in Sardinia and explore beyond our retreat locations. Shared airport transfers to and from Olbia Airport are included in your retreat package as per the details in the Includes & Itinerary sections.
You will need an adaptor to plug your devices into the European outlets. They can be picked up at most airports or you can order online.
Sardinia is very good about gluten free diets for those who have an intolerance. YEAH!
Our hiking excursions require proper hiking boots to protect your ankles whether you are doing the easy or the moderate

We require you to have medical insurance coverage while on retreat. If your policy covers you outside your home country please submit proof of that coverage to us or you may purchase travel medical insurance just for your trip with our insurance partners Insubuy.
Yoga mats are provided for you on this retreat.

faqs.question: Do you accept bitcoin?
answer: In addition to credit card payments we also accept wire transfers, Zelle and Bitcoin. Please inquire for more details.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
answer: All payments are 100% non refundable and non-transferable. We recommend that you buy Trip cancellation insurance immediately upon making your initial deposit to cover any travel hiccups or complications that may arise between now and the time of your retreat. No exceptions are possible so please cover your trip by connecting with an insurance company that offers the right policy for you.

faqs.question: What happens if my travel plans change?
answer: There are no refunds as per our cancellation policies. We highly recommend that all of our guests secure a quality travel insurance that will cover them for any event which may cause a change of travel plans, including personal health issues or personal situations in general which may affect travel plans.

faqs.question: Are flight delays or cancellations covered?
answer: Not by us: transportation delays, cancellations or changes due to strikes, labor disputes, or lockouts from airlines, boats, ferries or any type of transportation are among the events we recommend covering with travel insurance.

faqs.question: Where can I find the full terms & conditions?
answer: The full terms and conditions are published at https://yogaadventuresworldwide.com/termsandconditions/ . By submitting payments toward your retreat you accept them.
